slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Workshop: Module 2
slides.subtitle: Build and Ship an AI-Assisted Full-Stack App | August 3, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT

slides.title: What this covers
slides.body: How to use AI tools from product spec to deployed full-stack app.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: AI can generate frontend or backend code, but full-stack work fails when the parts drift apart.

slides.title: Main workflow
slides.body: Turn an app idea into a product spec and acceptance criteria. Use OpenAPI contracts to align frontend and backend work.

slides.title: What you will leave with
slides.body: Add tests, Docker, deployment, and CI/CD without losing the workflow.
